// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// THE ONE THAT MATTERS out of PR5's fixtures.
//
// MailSuppression is classified LOOKUP_ONLY, and this is the screen that class
// exists to refuse: a list of every adult the mail provider is currently
// refusing to deliver to. Each of those rows is a parent who is not receiving
// their sign-in link, which means a family who cannot see their child's work.
// Answering "is THIS address being refused" is support. Rendering all of them
// is a register of locked-out families, and nobody asked for one.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function everyRefusedAddress() {
  return db.mailSuppression.findMany({ select: { addressHmac: true, state: true } });
}
